qualifier: androgen together with estrogen and progesterone
name: Androgen, estrogen and progesterone receptor signaling
rationale: All members concern sex steroid receptor signaling and transcriptional responses; unlike the estrogen/progesterone neighbour it includes androgen-receptor and prostate responses, and unlike the androgen/bone neighbour it includes estrogen and progesterone receptors.

core: Transcriptional control of lipid and glucose metabolism
qualifier: by nuclear receptors and SREBP, including cholesterol homeostasis
name: Nuclear receptor and SREBP control of lipid metabolism
rationale: Members are nuclear receptor (LXR, PPARA, ROR/REV-ERB), PGC-1alpha and SREBP programs governing lipid, cholesterol and glucose metabolism; neighbours instead center on adipocyte differentiation or ChREBP sugar sensing.

qualifier: recombination-based, with break-induced replication
name: Recombination-based telomere maintenance and break-induced replication
rationale: Members cover telomere capping and recombination/D-loop/t-circle-based telomere maintenance plus break-induced replication and intra-S checkpoint; neighbours either lack the telomere processes or the break-induced replication and cell-division components.

qualifier: BCL-2 family control of outer membrane permeabilization, upstream of apoptosome
name: BCL-2 family control of mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization
rationale: All members concern BH3-only/BAX/BAK regulation of MOMP and cytochrome c release, while every confusable adds the downstream apoptosome, caspase and SMAC steps absent here.

qualifier: atypical RHOBTB, Rho and Ral GTPases
name: RHOBTB, Rho and Ral GTPase activity regulation
rationale: Members are GTPase cycles and activity regulation of RHOBTB, Rho effector and Ral GTPases; this separates it from the Rab/ARF neighbour and from the RHOBTB-with-neddylation/proteolysis neighbours.

qualifier: positive and negative control of alternative and classical routes
name: Regulation of alternative and classical complement activation
rationale: All members are positive or negative regulation of complement activation via alternative and classical pathways, whereas confusables comprise the activation cascade itself (C3/C5, lectin, antibody-mediated).

qualifier: cerebellar granule layer and brainstem, with motor and respiratory function
name: Cerebellar granule layer and brainstem development and function
rationale: Members cover cerebellar granule layer/Bergmann glia, pons and brainstem development plus motor learning and respiratory control; neighbours emphasize Purkinje layer, locomotor behavior, forebrain or hindbrain axon guidance instead.

qualifier: cardiac outflow tract, great arteries and trachea
name: Pharyngeal arch derivative and cardiac outflow tract development
rationale: Members are palate, thyroid, parathyroid, thymus, trachea and neural-crest-dependent outflow tract and pharyngeal arch artery development; confusables share the glandular/palate members but lack the outflow tract, arterial and tracheal ones, adding face and limb instead.

core: NAD and coenzyme A cofactor metabolism
qualifier: from niacin and pantothenate via salvage
name: Niacin- and pantothenate-derived NAD and coenzyme A metabolism
rationale: Members are nicotinate/NAD(P) salvage, transport and turnover plus pantothenate-to-coenzyme A synthesis; neighbours instead hold tryptophan-derived de novo NAD, creatine/adenine nucleotide transport, or pyruvate-to-acetyl-CoA.

qualifier: inherited immunodeficiency diseases
name: Inherited immunodeficiencies of TLR-MyD88-IRAK4-NF-kappaB signaling
rationale: All members are disease variants (MyD88, IRAK4, IKBKB, IKBKG, IkBA deficiency) disrupting TLR-NF-kappaB signaling, whereas confusables describe normal TLR, inflammasome or NF-kappaB signaling.

core: T and NK lymphocyte gene signatures
qualifier: shared T/NK activation expression
name: Shared T and NK cell activation signature
rationale: All three are co-expression modules for T cells, NK cells and T cell activation; neighbours are either NK-cytotoxicity regulation or T cell differentiation/TCR signaling programs.

qualifier: ventricular myocardium and second heart field
name: Ventricular myocardium morphogenesis and second heart field development
rationale: Members cover ventricular trabecular and compact myocardium, cardiomyocyte development and second heart field specification; neighbours instead add valves/endocardial cushion, septum, conduction system or left-right patterning.

qualifier: with lipophagy and triglyceride storage
name: Lipid droplet biogenesis, lipophagy and triglyceride storage
rationale: Members concern lipid droplet formation, fusion and breakdown, lipophagy and triglyceride storage; neighbours instead emphasize glycerolipid synthesis enzymology, fatty acid oxidation, LXR control or adipogenesis.

qualifier: with GLUT4 translocation and RHOQ/RHOT GTPase cycles
name: Endosomal trafficking, GLUT4 translocation and RHOQ/RHOT GTPase cycles
rationale: Members concern early endosome sorting, transcytosis, pinocytosis and membrane targeting; the RHOQ/RHOT GTPase cycles and GLUT4 translocation distinguish it from neighbours focused on endocytic cargo recognition, macropinocytosis or recycling.

qualifier: with liver development and regeneration
name: Thyroid hormone receptor signaling and liver development
rationale: Members are thyroid hormone/nuclear receptor transcription plus hepatocyte differentiation, proliferation and liver regeneration; neighbours share the thyroid receptor core but add retinoic acid, sex steroid or SREBP programs instead of liver.

qualifier: coronavirus and flavivirus, with budding-site assembly
name: Coronavirus and flavivirus structural protein maturation and assembly
rationale: Members are maturation of SARS-CoV E, spike and 3a and dengue proteins plus virion component assembly; neighbours cover viral entry, replicase translation or other viruses.

qualifier: post-translational: trafficking, interactions and degradation
name: Post-translational control of E-cadherin and cadherin-11
rationale: All three members concern CDH1/CDH11 protein processing, trafficking, binding and degradation, whereas neighbours concern cadherin gene transcription or junction assembly.

qualifier: with laminins, metallopeptidases and complement
name: Extracellular matrix and laminin co-expression signatures
rationale: All members are co-expression modules for extracellular matrix proteins, some with laminins, metallopeptidases and complement; neighbours are integrin/fibronectin, collagen/elastin or fibroblast pathways.

qualifier: lysosomal, with glycolipid transport
name: Lysosomal glycosphingolipid catabolism and glycolipid transport
rationale: Members are lysosomal ganglioside/glycosphingolipid degradation and its storage diseases plus glycolipid transport; neighbours add sialic acid and N-glycan metabolism or glycosphingolipid biosynthesis instead.

qualifier: elongation and termination
name: Ribosomal RNA transcription elongation and termination
rationale: Members are RNA polymerase I elongation/termination and 5S rRNA polymerase III transcription; neighbours cover Pol I initiation and chromatin, Pol III tRNA transcription, or rRNA processing.

qualifier: TRKA and TRKB downstream effectors
name: TRKA and TRKB neurotrophin receptor downstream signaling
rationale: Members are NGF/TRKA and BDNF-NT3/TRKB effector signaling (PI3K, CDK5, RAC1, ERK5, CREB); neighbours are TRKB-only or TRKC branches, or p75NTR signaling.

qualifier: mating, parental and aggressive behavior plus parturition
name: Sexual, parental and aggressive behavior and parturition
rationale: Members are mating, parental and aggressive behaviors and reproductive physiology (erection, insemination, parturition, uterine contraction); neighbours add tachykinin signaling, urinary smooth muscle or exploratory behaviors.

qualifier: spliceosome assembly and splice site recognition
name: Spliceosome assembly and pre-mRNA splice site recognition
rationale: All members concern spliceosome assembly, catalytic activation and major/minor intron splicing, whereas neighbours concern snRNA transcription, RNA decay or histone mRNA processing.

qualifier: peroxide-driven intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis
name: Regulation of oxidative stress-induced apoptosis and ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to hydrogen peroxide and nitrosative stress and their control of intrinsic apoptosis and ferroptosis; neighbours instead add ischemia, hydrogen sulfide or mitochondrial respiration control.

qualifier: bilirubin and drugs, with hyperbilirubinemia defects
name: Hepatic clearance of bilirubin and organic anion drugs
rationale: Members are OATP-mediated organic anion drug uptake, heme/bilirubin degradation and conjugation, and their hyperbilirubinemia defects; neighbours cover organic cation/xenobiotic transport or phase II metabolism without bilirubin.
